From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@finwave.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: reserved capacity architecture review (pool sizing / isolation)

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the run-through last week. We want to set up a focused architecture session to align on reserved GPU capacity for our production rollout — specifically pool sizing, autoscaling behavior under bursty traffic, and tenant isolation guarantees.

Could we book a 90-minute technical deep-dive next week? Our core attendees would be myself and two infra architects (cc'd on finwave-architects). Ideal windows: Tue/Wed 10:00-13:00 PT.

I've attached a short list of initial questions to help shape the agenda.

Best,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Platform Engineering, FinWave
attachments: FW-initial-questions.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: reserved capacity architecture review (pool sizing / isolation)

Hi Jane —

Thanks, this is great. We can definitely cover pool sizing, autoscale policies, KV cache warmup strategies, and per-tenant isolation patterns.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 13 10:00-11:30
- Tue Apr 13 11:30-13:00
- Wed Apr 14 10:00-11:30

Marissa (CC) will lead the session content — she has the dedicated playbook and the cost/perf tradeoff slides. Karthik, if you can join we'll cover autoscale knobs and failure modes.

I'll also invite our partner ops contact from CloudCo to discuss cross-cloud placement and network isolation.

If any of the proposed slots work, I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Cheers,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

On Sat, Apr 10, 2027 at 11:03 AM Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks, this is great. We can definitely cover pool sizing...

Jane / team — quick note from our side on agenda and prep so the session is efficient:

Agenda (90m):
- 10m: Introductions + success criteria (FinWave)
- 25m: Pool sizing methodology (traffic signal, percentile sizing, safety headroom)
- 20m: Autoscale mechanics & backpressure (concurrency, batching, cold starts)
- 20m: Isolation & multi-tenant considerations (network, KMS, log separation)
- 10m: Action items & roll-forward plan

Pre-reads: I've attached the Redwood Dedicated playbook excerpt to give context on our autoscale profiles and typical latency envelope — please skim pages 4-9.

Also, can you share an anonymized traffic sample (1 week, 95/99 pctiles) and any hard SLAs? That will help us bring a recommended initial pool size and a canary rollout plan.

We'll plan to record and produce a short runbook after the session.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
